signing.note: The `signature` / `_cosign_signature` field present in earlier manifests was a dev placeholder ("dev-signature"). It has been removed in V1; the real Ed25519-SHA256 cosign keyless signature lives in the sidecar file stable.json.sig, with the corresponding Fulcio certificate in stable.json.cert. Both are produced by the `.github/workflows/release.yml` `Sign stable.json (cosign keyless OIDC + Rekor)` step and shipped alongside stable.json on each GitHub Release. Verifiers MUST run `cosign verify-blob` with the sidecars (see docs/operations/update.md) — there is intentionally no inline signature in this JSON to avoid tampering-by-republish.
